Discovering solar energy

Semanoor Document Studio — demonstration lesson

1. Start with a question

How can sunlight help power a classroom? Solar panels turn energy from sunlight into electricity. The amount produced depends on sunlight, panel size and other conditions.

2. Explore the parts

PartWhat it does
Solar panelConverts sunlight into electricity
InverterChanges direct current into alternating current
BatteryStores energy for later use

3. Think and discuss

  • What changes when clouds cover the sun?
  • Where could a school place its panels?
  • Why might a battery be useful after sunset?

٤. اكتشف الطاقة الشمسية

تحوّل الألواح الشمسية طاقة ضوء الشمس إلى كهرباء. فكّر في الأماكن المناسبة لوضع الألواح في مدرستك، ثم ناقش أفكارك مع زملائك.

Learning objective

Explain the roles of a solar panel, inverter and battery using a simple classroom example.
